title: Wishlist/BiS now only show weapons your class can use
body: The Weapon and Off Hand rows in your Wishlist and the officer BiS grid used to mix in every class's weapons and shields. They're now filtered to what your class can actually equip -- e.g. a Mage no longer sees Maces or Polearms, and shields only show for Warrior/Paladin/Shaman. Also filtered out a handful of healer-only and tank-only trinkets from showing to the wrong role.

title: WGA Priority Loot addon linked from Wishlist and Loot pages
body: Your Wishlist tab now links the WGA Priority Loot addon -- install it in-game to see your Priority rank on items as they drop. Officers running the Priority Order system need it; it's optional for raiders.

title: Heads up when a slot's BiS already comes from Other Sources
body: If you've tagged M+, Crafted, or Catalyst as your BiS for a slot under Other Sources, opening that slot's own raid-drop card now tells you so -- easy to miss otherwise, since the two picks live on separate cards.

title: Clear My Wishlist button
body: Your Wishlist tab now has a Clear My Wishlist button that resets everything in one go -- every gear-slot tag and Other Sources pick -- instead of removing each one by hand. It asks you to confirm first, and only works while wishlist editing is open.

title: See who's already signed up when picking your class
body: Step 3 of Sign Up now shows who else already plays the class you pick. If you're signing up as Tank or Healer, you'll also see a heads up if the team already has enough -- you can still sign up either way, but it's worth considering DPS as backup or talking to an officer first.

title: New qualification checks for M+ exclusion
body: Requesting exclusion from the weekly M+ requirement now asks you to confirm you're 6/6 Myth in every M+ obtainable slot and to select how many of your 3 gem sockets (Helm/Bracer/Belt) are filled -- you need at least 2 of 3 to qualify. An officer still reviews every request before approving.

title: Priority tab and Wishlist got a visual refresh
body: Item rows in the Priority tab and your Wishlist now show a larger item icon next to the name, with stat pills (Crit/Haste/Mastery/Vers, whichever the item actually rolls) and the boss it drops from laid out more clearly.

title: Season 2 loot is in the catalog
body: The Venomous Abyss item list has been imported behind the scenes -- officers can already see it in the Priority tab and BiS picker. It'll show up in your Wishlist once Season Settings switches over to the new tier.

title: This News tab
body: You're looking at it -- a new News tab with a running feed of what's shipped, newest first. Click an entry to expand a short write-up. The red dot on the nav item clears once you visit.

title: BiS List now shows items in the right order
body: Your BiS List (on your profile and the officer's Roster view) was sometimes showing gear in a random order instead of head-to-toe. It now always sorts Head, Neck, Shoulder, Back, Chest, Wrist, Hands, Waist, Legs, Feet, Finger 1, Finger 2, Trinket 1, Trinket 2, Weapon, Off Hand.

title: Wishlist completeness indicator
body: Your Wishlist tab now shows "N/16 slots tagged" so you can see at a glance whether you've covered every gear slot -- it turns green once everything's covered and lists what's missing otherwise.

title: Wishlist tab reorganized into collapsible slot cards
body: The Wishlist tab used to be one long scroll. Each gear slot is now its own collapsible card with a colored dot showing how many items you've tagged there, and Other Sources (M+/Crafted) is now a single card instead of repeating on every slot.

title: My Wishlist: tag any item, not just your one BiS pick
body: Your profile now has a Wishlist tab where you can tag any item in your armor type as BiS, Good, OK, Catalyst Only, or Pass, with an optional note -- separate from (and shown alongside) the officer's single BiS pick per slot.

title: Meet the officers: new Bios tab
body: A new Bios tab introduces the team's raid officers -- photo, name, title, class/spec, and a short bio for each.

title: New History tab: past seasons at a glance
body: A new History tab lists every archived season, newest first, with the season's total Mythic kill count and the date of its last boss kill.

title: Search Recent Loot by item name
body: The landing page's Recent Loot feed now has a search box -- type an item name to see every match for the current season instead of just the last 10 drops.

title: Sign Up now shows and lets you edit your existing submission
body: Signing up when you've already submitted this season now shows your existing signup (status, class/spec, your note) with an Edit button instead of a blank form. Anything not yet added to the roster or denied can be corrected without asking an officer.
